macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. inflation comes in hotter than expected, lifting Fed hike bets
items.summary: September core CPI rose 2.6% year over year and 0.3% month over month, above expectations. Markets increased the probability of a 25-basis-point Fed hike later this month to roughly 47%, from about 22% previously.

items.title: Stocks slip after hot CPI report; Treasury yields rise
items.summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq moved lower after the inflation release, while Treasury yields climbed as investors reassessed the outlook for monetary policy. The Dow was relatively supported by healthcare stocks.

items.title: Fed official says another rate hike may be appropriate
items.summary: New York Fed President John Williams said one additional interest-rate increase may be appropriate this year, while leaving open the possibility of further action in 2027.

items.title: U.S. stock futures edge higher ahead of inflation data and bank earnings
items.summary: Before the CPI release, Dow futures rose about 0.2%, S&P 500 futures gained about 0.2%, and Nasdaq 100 futures were little changed. Bank of America, Morgan Stanley, and BlackRock were among the major companies reporting.

items.title: ASML raises annual forecast for the third time this year
items.summary: The Dutch semiconductor-equipment maker increased its annual outlook, citing strong demand for equipment used to build artificial-intelligence infrastructure and efforts to expand production.

items.title: Bank of America profit hit by $1.2 billion provision
items.summary: Bank of America reported lower third-quarter profit after setting aside $1.2 billion related to fines over failures to detect possible illicit activity.

items.title: China exports surge 36.3% year over year
items.summary: Chinese exports rose 36.3% in September, exceeding expectations and potentially increasing trade tensions with major commercial partners.

items.title: Anthropic expected to disclose quarterly revenue figures
items.summary: Anthropic reportedly planned to present third-quarter revenue figures to potential institutional investors at an investor event, providing an early look at the private AI company’s financial performance.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: SEC rule enables options on diversified crypto trusts
items.summary: A Cboe BZX rule change became operative on October 13, establishing listing criteria for options tied to commodity-based trusts holding multiple crypto assets.

items.title: South Korea moves to block 27 unregistered crypto exchange websites
items.summary: South Korea’s Financial Intelligence Unit approved blocking domestic access to 27 websites operated by unregistered exchanges, including KuCoin, MEXC, Phemex and Bitrue, and referred 44 operators for investigation.

items.title: Bitcoin and XRP sentiment turns bearish as prices weaken
items.summary: Bitcoin and XRP sentiment has deteriorated following price declines; XRP has fallen more than 9% over the week, while ether is drawing comparatively stronger bullish discussion.

items.title: Standard Chartered launches direct Bitcoin and Ether trading in UAE
items.summary: Standard Chartered began offering direct Bitcoin and Ether trading to affluent clients in the United Arab Emirates, expanding institutional-bank access to spot crypto markets.

items.title: Ripple partners with South Korea’s Meritz Securities
items.summary: Ripple and Meritz Securities announced a strategic partnership to explore using Ripple Custody and tokenization infrastructure in Korea’s capital markets.

items.title: Bitway token extends sharp rally
items.summary: Bitway reached a reported record high of $2.77 and had gained about 103% over seven days, placing it among the largest recent cryptocurrency movers.

items.title: Solana declines amid ETF outflows
items.summary: Solana fell about 9.34% over the week to roughly $107 as its exchange-traded funds recorded seven consecutive days of outflows and technical momentum weakened.

items.title: EasyA reaches $1.1 billion valuation and plans tokenized shares
items.summary: Blockchain and AI developer platform EasyA reportedly reached a $1.1 billion valuation and is targeting a 2027 public listing with plans to make its shares available on-chain.

items.title: Sberbank prepares crypto trading for all clients
items.summary: Russia’s Sberbank plans to open Bitcoin, Ether and USDT trading to all clients on December 1 after testing the service in its mobile application.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Argon globally
items.summary: Google released its Gemini 4 Argon model to developers and businesses worldwide, with availability through paid API access and selected Gemini consumer products. The launch targets coding, knowledge work, enterprise workflows and cyber defense.[1][2]

items.title: AI companies pursue recursive self-improvement
items.summary: Technology companies are increasingly automating machine-learning research so AI systems can help design and train improved versions of themselves. The effort could extend beyond AI into broader scientific research.[3]

items.title: Anthropic describes AI-built Git replacement
items.summary: Anthropic detailed Scion, a Git replacement developed for its monorepo with substantial assistance from Claude. The system was created as Anthropic’s daily code merges increased sharply.[1]

items.title: Meta expands algorithm-personalization features
items.summary: Meta is extending its AI-powered “Your Algorithm” feature from Instagram to Facebook and Facebook Reels, while increasing the use of large language models in content-ranking systems.[1]

items.title: NEURA Robotics introduces Neuron AI
items.summary: NEURA Robotics introduced Neuron AI, a multimodal foundation model for physical robotics that combines 3D vision, touch, audio, robot-state data, language and memory to support context-aware actions.[4]

items.title: Prime Intellect acquires Moondream
items.summary: Prime Intellect acquired Moondream and plans to integrate its open vision models and inference optimizations into Prime’s multimodal training and deployment platform. Financial terms were not disclosed.[2]

items.title: NVIDIA open-sources Run:ai platform components
items.summary: NVIDIA open-sourced the full Run:ai platform under its DSX AI Factory initiative, allowing organizations to adopt the integrated system or individual components for AI deployment and orchestration.[2]
